name: Parcy~Dice Bird of Paradise Garden
description: A warm community botanical-garden template built around the Bird of Paradise (Strelitzia), with a deep grove-green and cream palette, Strelitzia-orange accents, Fraunces display serif, and SVG-only art. Features a cycling garden-feed ribbon with live clock, a hero with a live grower counter and stylized bloom emblem, a collection grid of four Strelitzia varieties with bloom-season and rarity badges, animated count-up statistics, and a conservation-focused plant-care checklist centerpiece with four persisted lists and overall progress. Includes a fully validated 'Join the Grove' signup flow with loading, success, and duplicate-email states plus a persisted grower counter, garden helpline cards, share tools, scroll-reveal animations, mobile drawer navigation, reduced-motion support, and complete data-fws-slot content annotations.
